Gochi mancaatii kun hawaasa naannichaa keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: US Senate’s Fauci hearing renews COVID origin debate but reveals little
english: A recent US Senate hearing involving former pandemic advisor Anthony Fauci failed to provide new insights into the origins of COVID-19. Instead, the session highlighted ongoing political disagreements, with Republican lawmakers continuing to argue that the virus leaked from a Chinese laboratory. Experts noted that these repeated investigations have not advanced scientific understanding but have intensified partisan hostility.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜው የአሜሪካ ሴኔት ችሎት ስለ ኮቪድ-19 መነሻ ምንነት አዲስ መረጃ ማምጣት አልቻለም። በምርመራው ወቅት የሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ቫይረሱ ከቻይና ላብራቶሪ የወጣ መሆኑን በመከራከር በጉዳዩ ላይ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ልዩነት አሳይተዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት ይህ በተደጋጋሚ የሚካሄድ ክርክር ሳይንሳዊ እውነታን ከመፈለግ ይልቅ የፖለቲካ ክፍፍልን የሚያባብስ ነው።
oromo: Waltajjii seeneetiin biyya Ameerikaa keessatti gaggeeffame kan Dr. Anthony Fauci hirmaachise, waa'ee jalqaba vaayirasii COVID-19 irratti ragaa haaraa tokko illee hin fidne. Kutaaleen siyaasaa garaagaraa yaada wal-faallessuun irratti mari'atanis, miseensonni paartii Ripaabilikanii vaayirasichi laaboraatorii Chaayinaa keessaa akka ba'e amanuu isaanii itti fufaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, falmiin kun jijjiirama saayinsawaa fiduu mannaa, wal-qoodinsa siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti gadi fageesseera.

title: Pathirage beats Chopra and Nadeem to win Commonwealth gold in javelin
english: Sri Lankan athlete Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage made history by winning his country's first-ever Commonwealth Games gold medal in the javelin throw. He outperformed top competitors including Neeraj Chopra, who secured the silver medal, while defending champion Arshad Nadeem was eliminated early. The 23-year-old former cricketer achieved his winning distance of 89.75 meters despite difficult weather conditions in Glasgow.
amharic: የስሪ ላንካው አትሌት ሩሜሽ ታራንጋ ፓቲራጌ በጦር ውርወራ ውድድር የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ በማግኘት ለሀገሩ የመጀመሪያውን የኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ ታሪክ አስመዝግቧል። ፓቲራጌ የብር ሜዳሊያውን ያገኘውን ኒራጅ ቾፕራን በመብለጥ ድል የቀናው ሲሆን፣ የውድድሩ ተጠባቂ የነበረው አርሻድ ናዴም ቀደም ብሎ ከውድድሩ ወጥቷል። የቀድሞ የክሪኬት ተጫዋች የሆነው የ23 ዓመቱ አትሌት፣ በግላስጎው በተካሄደው አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ ውስጥ 89.75 ሜትር በመወርወር አሸናፊ ሆኗል።
oromo: Atileetiin biyya Sri Lanka Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage dargaa foonii (javelin) irratti injifannoo argachuun biyya isaaaf medaliyaa warqee jalqabaa seenaa tapha Commonwealth galchuu danda'eera. Pathirage dorgomtoota cimaa kan akka Neeraj Chopra (medaliyaa meetii argate) injifachuun yoo milkaa'u, dorgomaan cimaan Arshad Nadeem immoo sadarkaa jalqabaarratti mo'amee ba'eera. Umuriin isaa waggaa 23 kan ta'e fi kanaan dura taphataa kriket ture kun, haala qilleensa Glasgow kan rakkisaa ta'e keessatti fageenya meetira 89.75 fageessuun injifannoo argateera.

title: Children face higher threat of US deportation as legal support deal expires
english: A federal contract providing legal services to approximately 24,000 unaccompanied migrant children in the United States has expired, leaving their future representation uncertain. Advocates fear this gap will make these minors significantly more vulnerable to deportation under the current administration's strict immigration policies. The government has yet to announce a successor program or clarify how these children will receive the legal support they require.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ያለ አጃቢ ለሚገኙ ወደ 24,000 የሚጠጉ ህፃናት የህግ አገልግሎት ሲሰጥ የነበረው የፌደራል ውል መጠናቀቁ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ይህ ሁኔታ ህፃናቱ በስደት ላይ ባለው የአሜሪካ መንግስት ጥብቅ የኢሚግሬሽን ህግ መሰረት የመባረር እድላቸውን ከፍ እንደሚያደርገው የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች አስታውቀዋል። መንግስት ተተኪ ፕሮግራም ይፋ ያላደረገ ሲሆን፣ ህፃናቱ ወደፊት የህግ ድጋፍ እንዴት እንደሚያገኙ ግልጽ አልሆነም።
oromo: USA keessatti ijoollee gargaarsa nama biraa malee godaanan gara 24,000 ta’aniif tajaajila seeraa kennaa ture tokko xumuramuu isaatiin walqabatee rakkoon uumameera. Gargaartonni mirga namoomaa akka jedhanitti, dhabamuun gargaarsa kanaa ijoolleen kunneen dhiibbaa siyaasa immigreeshinii mootummaa ammaa jala oolanii akka ari’aman sodaachiseera. Mootummaan hanga ammaatti bakka buutuuf karoorri ifatti waan hin baaneef, ijoolleen kunneen gara fuulduraatti akkamitti deeggarsa seeraa akka argatan ifa miti.

title: Iran says ready to target Israeli, US infrastructure in response to potential ‘American recklessness’
english: A high-ranking Iranian security official announced that the country has developed a strategy to retaliate against any aggressive actions from the United States. Should Washington or its allies initiate attacks, Iran intends to strike essential facilities, including energy networks, within Israel and the broader region. This warning comes as a direct response to concerns regarding potential Western military aggression.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ባለሥልጣን አገራቸው በአሜሪካ በኩል የሚመጣን ማንኛውንም ጥቃት ለመመከት የሚያስችል ዝግጅት ማድረጓን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ወይም አጋሮቿ ጥቃት ቢሰነዝሩ ኢራን በእስራኤል እና በአካባቢው በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የአጸፋ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ማቀዷን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው ሊፈጸም ይችላል ተብሎ በሚሰጋው የምዕራባውያን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iran akka ibsanitti, biyyattiin tarkaanfii waraanaa Ameerikaa irraa isheen dhufu kamiyyuu dura dhaabbachuuf qophiin ishee xumuruu beeksisaniiru. Yoo Ameerikaan ykn biyyoonni ishee deggeran miidhaa geessisan, Iran bu'uuraalee misoomaa Israa'el fi dhaabbilee anniisaa Ameerikaa naannichatti argaman irratti tarkaanfii deebii kennuuf karoorfateetti. Akeekkachiisni kun kan kenname sodaa miidhaa waraanaa lixaan biyyootaa irraa ishee qunnamuu danda'u ilaalchisee dha.

title: UK, UAE discuss situation in the Middle East, Strait of Hormuz
english: British official Ed Miliband met with UAE Deputy Prime Minister Abdullah bin Zayed to address regional instability in the Middle East. The two leaders emphasized the importance of ensuring safe and uninterrupted maritime travel through the Strait of Hormuz. Furthermore, they pledged to strengthen the bilateral relationship between the UK and the UAE to foster mutual economic success.
amharic: የብሪታንያው ባለስልጣን ኤድ ሚሊባንድ ከተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ምክትል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አብዱላህ ቢን ዘይድ ጋር በመገናኘት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ስላለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ መክረዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር ላይ ጉዞ ደህንነትንና ነፃነትን ማስጠበቅ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። በተጨማሪም በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት እና የጋራ ብልጽግና ለማጠናከር ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyyoota UK fi UAE, kanneen akka Ed Miliband fi Abdullah bin Zayed, haala nageenyaa giddu galeessa bahaa irratti mari'ataniiru. Marii isaanii keessatti, bakka lafa Hormuz keessatti nageenyaa fi bilisummaan qaxxaamura galaanaa akka eegamu irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Kana malees, gamtaan kun guddina diinagdee fi bu'aa waloo biyyoota lamaanii mirkaneessuuf walitti dhufeenya isaanii cimsuuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Columbia University student workers’ union withdraws Israel divestment demand
english: The student workers' union at Columbia University has decided to drop its formal demand for the school to divest from Israel. This choice was made by the organization's members during a recent meeting regarding their contract negotiations. By removing this article, the group is no longer pushing for the university to disclose all its financial holdings or divest from companies based on international law violations.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የተማሪዎች ሠራተኛ ማህበር ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከእስራኤል ጋር ያለውን የገንዘብ ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጥ ያቀርብ የነበረውን ጥያቄ ሰርዟል። ማህበሩ ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰነው በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የውል ድርድር ወቅት በአባላቱ ድምፅ ነው። በዚህም መሰረት ማህበሩ ዩኒቨርሲቲው የገንዘብ ዝርዝሩን እንዲያሳውቅ እና በአለም አቀፍ ህግ ጥሰት ላይ ተመስርተው ኢንቨስትመንቶችን እንዲያቆም ሲጠይቅ የነበረውን አንቀፅ ከስምምነቱ ውጭ አድርጓል።
oromo: Tokkummaan hojjettoota barattoota Yuunivarsiitii Kolombiyaa, yuunivarsiitiin sun Israa'el keessaa maallaqa isaa akka baasu gaafachaa ture haquu isaa beeksiseera. Murtoon kun kan darbe yeroo marii waliigaltee kaffaltii fi hojii irratti miseensonni tokkummaa kun sagalee kennaniin dha. Kanaafuu, tokkummaan kun ammayyuu yuunivarsiitiin qabeenya isaa akka ifa godhu ykn seera idil-addunyaa cabsuudhaan himatamanii kanneen irratti invastmentii akka dhaabu gaaffii dhiyeessaa ture dhiiseera.

title: US Centcom says ’30 commerical vessels’ redirected during Iran blockade
english: The US Central Command reported that it has managed maritime traffic amidst an Iranian blockade by redirecting 30 commercial ships and stopping two others for compliance inspections. Additionally, the military successfully facilitated the passage of nearly 30 vessels carrying humanitarian aid. These actions were taken to maintain safe navigation and ensure that essential supplies reach their destinations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም በአሁኑ ወቅት እየተካሄደ ባለው የኢራን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ሳቢያ 30 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ ማስቀየሩን እና ሁለት መርከቦችንም ለቁጥጥር ማቆሙን አስታውቋል። በተጨማሪም ወታደራዊው ክፍል ለሰብአዊ እርዳታ የተጫኑ ወደ 30 የሚጠጉ መርከቦች በደህና እንዲያልፉ ፈቅዷል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች የባህር ላይ ጉዞን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እና እርዳታ ለሚፈልጉ ሰዎች በፍጥነት እንዲደርስ ለማድረግ የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Ajajni Giddu-galeessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) duula uggura galaanaa kan Iraan taasiftuun wal-qabatee, markaboota daldalaa 30 gara karaa biraatti akka geesseefi markaboota lama ammoo qorannoodhaaf akka dhaabde ibseera. Kana malees, waraanni kun markaboota gargaarsa namoomaa fe'an kanneen 30 ta'an karaa nageenyaan akka darban hayyamera. Tarkaanfiiwwan kun kan fudhataman nagaa karaa galaanaa eeguufi gargaarsi barbaachisu bakka ga'uuf akka danda'uufi.

title: Cambridge students on why they protested at graduation ceremony
english: Several students at Cambridge University staged protests during their graduation ceremonies to express their opposition to the institution's financial ties to Israel. The students were motivated by reports that the university's large endowment fund contains nearly $189 million invested in companies linked to the Israeli state. By choosing this significant event to voice their concerns, the protesters aimed to draw attention to the university's investment policies.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከእስራኤል ጋር ባለው የገንዘብ ግንኙነት በመቃወም በምረቃ ስነ-ስርዓታቸው ላይ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ተማሪዎቹ ይህን እርምጃ የወሰዱት የዩኒቨርሲቲው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ፈንድ ከ189 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ከእስራኤል ጋር በተያያዙ ድርጅቶች ላይ ኢንቨስት መደረጉን በመቃወም ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የምረቃ ቀናቸውን እንደ መድረክ በመጠቀም የዩኒቨርሲቲውን የኢንቨስትመንት ፖሊሲ በአደባባይ እንዲወያዩበት አድርገዋል።
oromo: Barattoonni Yuunivarsitii Kaambiriijii tokko tokko, yuunivarsitiin isaanii Israa'elii wajjin hariiroo maallaqaa qabaachuu isaatiin mormii dhageessisaniiru. Barattoonni kun kanneen mormii kana kaasanii, qabeenyi yuunivarsitichaa miiliyoona 189 dolaaraa ta'u dhaabbilee Israa'elii wajjin hariiroo qaban keessatti kasaaraa jiraachuu isaatiin akka ta'e ibsameera. Barattoonni kun guyyaa eebba isaanii akka carraa tokkootti fayyadamuun, siyaasa invastimantii yuunivarsitichaa mormuu isaanii beeksisaniiru.

title: Powerful El Nino to intensify heat on ‘a planet already on fire’: UN
english: The United Nations warns that a strengthening El Nino event will significantly increase global temperatures, leading to more frequent heatwaves, droughts, and floods. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has called for an immediate end to new fossil fuel projects to combat the worsening climate crisis. Experts urge governments to move beyond simple warnings and take urgent, concrete actions to protect vulnerable populations from these extreme weather conditions.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እየጠነከረ የመጣው የኤል নিনዮ ክስተት በዓለም ላይ ያለውን የሙቀት መጠን በእጅጉ እንደሚጨምርና ይህም ከባድ የሙቀት ማዕበል፣ ድርቅና ጎርፍ እንደሚያስከትል አስጠንቅቋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ የአየር ንብረት ቀውሱን ለመቀነስ አዳዲስ የቅሪተ አካል ነዳጅ ፕሮጀክቶችን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ባለሙያዎች መንግስታት ከማስጠንቀቂያ ባለፈ ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ማህበረሰቦችን ከእነዚህ አደገኛ የአየር ሁኔታዎች ለመጠበቅ ተግባራዊ እርምጃዎችን እንዲወስዱ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, yeroon El Nino daran jabaachaa jiru ho’a addunyaa dabaluun hongee, lolaa fi qilleensa ho’a baay’ee hammaataa ta’e akka fidee dhufu akeekkachiiseera. Barreessaa Olaanaan UN Antonio Guterres, balaa qilleensaa kanarraa furmaata argachuuf sagantaalee boba’aa gubataa haaraa hundeeffachuu hatattamaan akka dhaaban gaafataniiru. Ogeeyyiin mootummoonni akeekkachiisa qofa irratti utuu hin taane, ummata miidhamuu danda’an balaa kana irraa ittisuuf tarkaanfii qabatamaa akka fudhatan jajjabeessu.

title: Venezuela gov’t and opposition to hold talks aimed at path to elections
english: The Venezuelan government and a portion of the opposition are beginning US-supported negotiations to establish a framework for future elections. Former lawmaker Dinorah Figuera will lead the opposition delegation, while Jorge Rodriguez will represent the government, even though prominent opposition leader Maria Corina Machado was excluded from the proceedings. The talks aim to address issues like electoral reform and the lifting of sanctions, though the process has faced criticism from various political factions.
amharic: የቬኔዝዌላ መንግስት እና የተወሰነው ተቃዋሚ አካል ለወደፊት ምርጫዎች መንገድ ለመክፈት በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ ድርድር ሊጀምሩ ነው። በድርድሩ ላይ ዋና ተቃዋሚ መሪ ማሪያ ኮሪና ማቻዶ ሳይጋበዙ የቀሩ ሲሆን፣ የውይይቱ መሪዎች ዲኖራ ፊጌራ እና ጆርጅ ሮድሪጌዝ ይሆናሉ። ድርድሩ የምርጫ ስርዓት ማሻሻያን እና ማዕቀቦችን ማንሳትን ያካትታል ተብሎ የሚጠበቅ ቢሆንም፣ ሂደቱ ከተለያዩ የፖለቲካ ወገኖች ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Venzuwelaa fi kutaan mormituu tokko gara fuulduraatti filannoo gaggeessuuf karra banuuf jedhanii marii Ameerikaan deggeramu eegaluuf jiru. Marii kana irratti hogganaan mormituu beekamaan Maariyaa Koriinaa Maachadoo kan hin hirmaanne yoo ta'u, bakka buutonni gama lamaanii Diinoraa Fiigeraa fi Joorj Roodriigez ta'u. Mariin kun sirreeffama filannoo fi kaafamuu sanadaa irratti xiyyeeffata jedhamee kan eegamu yoo ta'u, gareewwan siyaasaa garaa garaa irraa komiin irratti ka'aa jira.

title: At least 25 people killed, dozens injured in Algeria bus crash
english: A tragic bus accident in Algeria has resulted in the deaths of at least 25 individuals. The vehicle fell into a ravine located in the coastal town of Bourmedes, near the capital city. In addition to the fatalities, many other passengers sustained injuries during the crash.
amharic: በአልጄሪያ በደረሰ አሳዛኝ የአውቶቡስ አደጋ ቢያንስ 25 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አውቶቡሱ ከዋና ከተማዋ አልጀርስ አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው ቡርመደስ በተባለች የባህር ዳርቻ ከተማ ውስጥ ወደሚገኝ ገደል ውስጥ ገብቷል። ከሟቾች በተጨማሪ በርካታ መንገደኞች በደረሰው አደጋ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Aljeeriya keessatti balaa konkolaataa busii mudateen namoonni 25 ol ta’an lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Busichi magaalaa guddittii Aljeers irraa gara kiiloo meetira 50 fagaattee argamtu, magaalaa Buurmeedes jedhamtu keessatti gara korama gadi fagoo tokkotti kufeera. Lubbuu darbe malees, namoonni hedduun balaa kana keessatti miidhamaniiru.

title: Columbia University student workers’ union withdraws Israel divestment demand
english: The Columbia University student workers' union has officially dropped its demand for the institution to divest from companies linked to Israel. This decision marks a significant shift for the union, which had previously been a vocal supporter of pro-Palestinian protest movements. The move occurred during ongoing contract negotiations as the union struggles to reach a new agreement with university administration.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የተማሪዎች ሠራተኛ ማኅበር እስራኤልን ከሚደግፉ ኩባንያዎች የገንዘብ ድጋፍን እንዲያቋርጥ ያቀረበውን ጥያቄ በይፋ አንስቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከዚህ ቀደም ለፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ተቃውሞዎች ድምፅ ሲሰጥ ለነበረው ማኅበር ትልቅ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ነው። ማኅበሩ ከዩኒቨርሲቲው አስተዳደር ጋር አዲስ የሥራ ውል ለመፈራረም በሚያደርገው ድርድር ወቅት ነው ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው።
oromo: Gamtaan hojjettoota barattoota Yuunivarsiitii Kolombiyaa yuunivarsiitiin sun kampanilee Israa'el deeggaran irraa qabeenya isaa akka baasu gaafachaa ture haqeera. Murteen kun gamtichaa fi sochiiwwan deggartoota Palastxiiin dur turan irratti jijjiirama guddaa agarsiisa. Murteen kun kan dhufe, gamtichi bulchiinsa yuunivarsiitii waliin marii walii galtee haaraa irratti utuu jiruu dha.

title: US, Israel planning to bombard energy-related targets in Iran, CBS reports
english: The United States and Israel are reportedly preparing for potential airstrikes against Iranian energy facilities. Although coordination between the two nations is underway, American officials have not yet received official authorization to begin the operation. Reports indicate that these strikes could potentially occur as early as this weekend.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል በኢራን የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር እቅድ እየያዙ መሆናቸውን ዘገባዎች ይጠቁማሉ። ሁለቱ አገራት በትብብር እየሰሩ ቢሆንም፣ የጥቃቱ የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ ግን እስካሁን አልተላለፈም። እነዚህ የአየር ድብደባዎች በዚህ ቅዳሜና እሁድ ሊፈጸሙ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Israa'el bu'uuraalee misooma anniisaa Iraan irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf qophii gochaa akka jiran gabaasni ni ibsa. Biyyoonni lamaan waliin ta'uun karooricha irratti mari'achaa jiranis, hamma ammaatti ajajni dhumaa hin kennamne. Haleellaan kun dhuma torban kanaatti raawwatamuu akka danda'u himameera.

title: The 'Board of Peace' announced a Palestinian body will take Hamas weapons. That's not what Trump said
english: President Donald Trump stated that the 'Board of Peace' would collect weapons from Hamas during the group's disarmament process. However, the Board had previously announced that a Palestinian technocratic body, the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza, would be responsible for controlling these weapons. This discrepancy highlights confusion regarding the implementation of the disarmament plan, though some analysts suggest the Board may ultimately hand the weapons to Egypt to ensure they remain out of Hamas's reach.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሃማስ ታጣቂዎች ትጥቅ ሲፈቱ መሳሪያዎቹን የሚረከበው 'የሰላም ቦርድ' እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ቦርዱ ቀደም ብሎ ባወጣው መግለጫ መሳሪያዎቹን የሚቆጣጠረው የጋዛ አስተዳደር ብሔራዊ ኮሚቴ የተባለ የፍልስጤማውያን አካል እንደሆነ አስታውቆ ነበር። ይህ የአስተያየት ልዩነት ትጥቅ የማስፈታት ዕቅዱ አፈጻጸም ላይ ግራ መጋባትን ፈጥሯል፤ አንዳንድ ባለሙያዎች ግን የሰላም ቦርዱ መሳሪያዎቹን ለግብፅ በማስረከብ ከሃማስ እጅ እንዲወጡ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ይገምታሉ።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Donald Traamp akka jedhanitti, gareen Haamaas hidhanno hiikkachuu yeroo jalqabu meeshaan waraanaa harka 'Board of Peace' jala galu qaba. Haa ta'u malee, boardichi kanaan dura ibsa baaseen, meeshaan waraanaa kun harka qaama hoji raawwachiiftuu Filisxeem kan 'National Committee for the Administration of Gaza' jedhamu jalatti akka galu ibsee ture. Wal-dhabbiin kun karoora hidhannoo hiikkachiisuu irratti shakkii uumullee, xiinxaltoonni tokko tokko 'Board of Peace' kun meeshaa kana gara fuulduraatti gara biyya Gibxii erguudhaan harka Haamaas akka hin galle gochuu akka danda'an dubbatu.

title: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian in Gaza City, report says
english: Recent Israeli drone and air strikes in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least two Palestinians. One individual was killed in Gaza City's Sabra neighborhood, while another died following an attack on Salah al-Din Street. Emergency medical teams confirmed these casualties earlier today.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል ድሮን እና የአየር ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸው ተሰምቷል። አንዱ ግለሰብ በጋዛ ከተማ ሳብራ ሰፈር ሲገደሉ፣ ሌላኛው ደግሞ በሳላህ አል-ዲን ጎዳና ላይ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የአደጋ ጊዜ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የሁለቱን ሰዎች ሞት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Hojiin xiyyaaraa fi rukutaan xiyyaara maleeyyii (doroonee) Israa'el gaazaatti raawwatameen namoonni Palestiinii lama du'aniiru. Namni tokko naannoo Saabraa magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti yoo ajjeefamu, kan biraan ammoo daandii Salaah al-Diin irratti erga rukutamee booda du'eera. Ogeeyyoonni fayyaa ariifachiisaa du'a namoota kanaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: The Gaza genocide has turned the Palestinian question into the Israeli problem
english: The ongoing conflict in Gaza since late 2023 has resulted in the deaths of over 73,000 Palestinians and represents a major shift in the geopolitical landscape. This violence has highlighted the nature of the Zionist movement as a settler-colonial project aimed at displacing the indigenous population. Consequently, the crisis is increasingly viewed as a fundamental Israeli problem rather than just a regional struggle for Palestinian rights.
amharic: ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ከ73,000 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያንን በመግደል በታሪክ ውስጥ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ከፍቷል። ይህ አሰቃቂ ድርጊት የጽዮናዊነት ንቅናቄን ተፈጥሮ ለዓለም በማጋለጥ፣ ፍልስጤማውያንን ከመሬታቸው የማፈናቀል እና የማጥፋት ዓላማ እንዳለው አሳይቷል። በውጤቱም፣ ጉዳዩ የፍልስጤማውያን ብቻ ሳይሆን የእስራኤል እራሷን መሠረታዊ ችግር እንደሆነ ተደርጎ እየታየ ነው።
oromo: Waraana Gaza keessatti Mudde 2023 irraa eegalee geggeeffamaa jiruun lubbuun namoota Falasxiin 73,000 ol ta'uun isaa seenaa keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fideera. Gochi kun dhaabbata Zayoniizimii kan biyya bulchuuf jedhee uummata naannoo sanaa buqqisuu fi balleessuuf karoora qabu ta'uu isaa adunyaatti ifa godheera. Kanaan kan ka'es, rakkoon kun amma qofa gaaffii Falasxiin miti; rakkoo hundee Israa'el kan ta'e dhimma guddaa ta'ee mul'ateera.

title: Does FIFA need private investment?
english: FIFA is facing significant criticism after proposing to sell minority stakes in major tournaments like the World Cup to private investors to boost global football development. While FIFA President Gianni Infantino advocates for the plan as a way to increase funding for member nations, major confederations across Europe, Asia, and North America are strongly opposed. This disagreement has caused internal tension, including the resignation of a high-ranking adviser to the FIFA president.
amharic: ፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫን ጨምሮ በዋና ዋና ውድድሮች ላይ የድርሻ ሽያጭ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለማቅረብ ያቀረበው ሀሳብ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ይህ እርምጃ ለሁሉም አባል ሀገራት ተጨማሪ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደሚገኝ ቢከራከሩም፣ የአውሮፓ፣ የእስያ እና የሰሜን አሜሪካ እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ዕቅዱን አጥብቀው ተቃውመዋል። በጉዳዩ ላይ በተፈጠረው አለመግባባትም የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ከፍተኛ አማካሪ ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል።
oromo: FIFA dorgommiwwan gurguddoo kan akka 'World Cup' irratti hirmaannaa dhuunfaa gurguruuf karoorfachuun isaa mormii cimaa ta'eef saaxileera. Preezidaantiin FIFA Jaannii Infaantiinoo akka jedhanitti, tajaajilli kun biyyoota miseensa ta'aniif faayidaa maallaqaa guddaa argamsiisa jedhanii amanu. Haa ta'u malee, federeeshinoonni gurguddoon Awurooppaa, Eeshiyaa fi Ameerikaa Kaabaa karoora kana irratti mormii cimaa qabu; mormii kana hordofees gorsaan ol aanaan preezidaantii FIFA hojii gadhiisaniiru.

title: Algerian bus plunges into ravine killing at least 27
english: A passenger bus traveling from Setif to Algiers crashed into a ravine in northern Algeria, resulting in the deaths of at least 27 people and injuring 39 others. Following this tragic accident, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune announced three days of national mourning and promised a strict investigation into those responsible. Authorities are investigating the cause of the crash, as road accidents remain a significant concern in the country.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ አልጄሪያ ከሴቲፍ ወደ አልጄርስ ሲጓዝ የነበረ መንገደኞችን የጫነ አውቶቡስ ገደል ውስጥ በመግባቱ ቢያንስ 27 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 39 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህንን አሳዛኝ ክስተት ተከትሎ ፕሬዝዳንት አብደልማጂድ ተቦን የሶስት ቀን የሀዘን ቀንን አውጀው፣ ለድርጊቱ ተጠያቂ በሆኑ አካላት ላይ ጥብቅ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድ ቃል ገብተዋል። በአልጄሪያ የትራፊክ አደጋዎች ከፍተኛ ስጋት በመሆናቸው ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Aljeeriya kaabaatti namoota hedduu fe'atee magaalaa Setif irraa gara Aljeers imalaa kan ture konkolaataan tokko boolla keessa bu'ee namoota 27 ol yoo ajjeesu, namoonni 39 ammoo miidhama argataniiru. Balaa gaddisiisaa kana booda pirezidaantiin biyyattii Abdeelmajiid Tebboon guyyoota sadan gadda biyyoolessaa labsuun, namoota balaa kanaaf itti gaafatamtoota ta'an irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galaniiru. Balaan daandii biyyattii keessatti rakkoo cimaa waan ta'eef, aangessitoonni sababa balaa kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: ‘Strategic partner’: Peru’s Fujimori plans to intensify ties with the US
english: Peru's new president, Keiko Fujimori, aims to strengthen the country's relationship with the United States, viewing it as a vital strategic partner. Foreign Minister Carlos Espa announced plans for Peru to join the U.S.-led 'Shield of the Americas' coalition to combat criminal networks. Additionally, the administration intends to mend diplomatic relations with neighboring countries like Mexico, Colombia, and Venezuela.
amharic: የፔሩ አዲሷ ፕሬዝዳንት ኬይኮ ፉጂሞሪ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር አቅደዋል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ካርሎስ ኤስፓ እንደገለጹት ፔሩ ወንጀለኞችን ለመዋጋት በአሜሪካ የሚመራውን 'የአሜሪካ ጋሻ' ጥምረት ለመቀላቀል ዝግጅት እያደረገች ነው። ከዚህም በላይ መንግስታቸው እንደ ሜክሲኮ፣ ኮሎምቢያ እና ቬንዙዌላ ካሉ ጎረቤት ሀገራት ጋር የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነቱን ለመጠገን ይፈልጋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii biyya Peeruu haaraan Keiko Fujimori hariiroo biyyattii Ameerikaa waliin qabdu caalaatti jabeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa biyyattii Carlos Espa akka ibsanitti, Peeruun gurmuu Ameerikaan durfamuu fi 'Shield of the Americas' jedhamu kan yakka ittisuuf ijaarameef makamuuf jirti. Kana malees, mootummaan kun biyyoota ollaa akka Meeksiikoo, Kolombiyaa fi Veenezueelaa waliin hariiroo diippiloomaasii durii deebisanii ijaaruuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Poland protests to Russian ambassador over missile incursion
english: Poland has officially protested to the Russian ambassador after a Russian missile landed in Polish territory. Officials confirmed the projectile was a newly manufactured Kh-101 missile, suggesting Russia is struggling with supply shortages during its ongoing war in Ukraine. This incident has raised serious concerns about the potential for the conflict to spill over into neighboring NATO countries.
amharic: የሩሲያ ሚሳኤል በፖላንድ ግዛት ውስጥ ማረፉን ተከትሎ ፖላንድ በሩሲያ አምባሳደር ላይ ኦፊሴላዊ ተቃውሞ አቅርባለች። ሚሳኤሉ በቅርቡ የተመረተ የKh-101 አይነት መሆኑ የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን ይህም ሩሲያ በዩክሬን እያካሄደች ባለው ጦርነት የጦር መሣሪያ እጥረት እየገጠማት መሆኑን ያሳያል። ይህ ክስተት ጦርነቱ ወደ ጎረቤት የኔቶ አገራት ሊዛመት ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Xiyyaan Raashiyaa tokko biyya Poolaandi keessatti kufuu isaa hordofee, mootummaan Poolaandi ambaasaaddara Raashiyaa waamuudhaan mormii isaa ibseera. Xiyyichi kutaalee dhiyeenya kana oomishamanii fi Kh-101 jedhamanii beekaman kan ta'e yoo ta'u, kunis Raashiyaan waraana Yukreenii irratti gaggeessitu keessatti meeshaan waraanaa ishee xiqqaachaa akka jiru agarsiisa. Ta'iinsi kun waraanni kun gara biyyoota ollaa kanneen Neetoo (NATO) keessatti babal'achuu danda'a jedhanii akka yaadda'an isaan taasiseera.

title: Trump says US has ‘understanding’ with Israel on Hamas disarmament deal
english: US President Donald Trump claims to have an agreement with Israel regarding a plan to disarm Hamas in exchange for withdrawing Israeli forces from Gaza. While Trump describes this as a major breakthrough, Israel has not yet officially accepted the proposal, with some government officials voicing strong opposition. The situation remains uncertain as negotiations continue, despite Hamas expressing willingness to move forward with the initial stages of the deal.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሀማስ ትጥቁን እንዲፈታና እስራኤልም ከጋዛ ለቃ እንድትወጣ የሚያደርግ ስምምነት ላይ ከእስራኤል ጋር መግባባታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ትራምፕ ይህን ስምምነት ትልቅ ድል እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ እስራኤል ግን እስካሁን በይፋ አልተቀበለችውም፤ አልፎ ተርፎም አንዳንድ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት እቅዱን እንደሚቃወሙት ገልጸዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው የድርድር ሂደት አሁንም ውስብስብ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, Hamas meeshaa waraanaa isaa hiikkatee fi Israa'el immoo Gaazaa keessaa akka baatu qophiin waliigaltee tokko jiraachuu ibsaniiru. Tiraamp adeemsa kana injifannoo guddaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, Israa'el waliigaltee kana ammayyuu guututti kan hin fudhanne ta'uu fi qondaalonni Israa'el tokko tokko immoo mormii qaban ibsaniiru. Hamas jalqaba irratti waliigaltee kanaaf fedhii kan qabu ta'us, mariin kun ammayyuu xumura hin arganne.

title: World reacts with cautious optimism to Hamas disarmament agreement
english: Hamas has reached a conditional agreement to disarm in phases as part of a new plan to end the nearly three-year war in Gaza. In exchange for the group giving up its weapons, Israeli forces are expected to withdraw from the territory. While international mediators and the U.S. government view this as a historic path toward peace, many remain skeptical about its success due to past failed ceasefires and deep-seated mutual distrust.
amharic: ሃማስ በጋዛ ለሦስት ዓመታት የዘለቀውን ጦርነት ለማቆም በደረጃ ትጥቅ ለመፍታት የሚያስችል ስምምነት ላይ ደርሷል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት ሃማስ መሳሪያውን ሲያስረክብ እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ እንደምታስወጣ ይጠበቃል። ዓለም አቀፍ አደራዳሪዎች ይህንን ስምምነት ለሰላም ወሳኝ እርምጃ አድርገው ቢወስዱትም፣ ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የሰላም ጥረቶች በመክሸፋቸው እና በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ባለው ከፍተኛ አለመተማመን የተነሳ ስምምነቱ በተግባር ላይ ስለመዋሉ ጥርጣሬዎች አሉ።
oromo: Hamaas waraana waggaa sadiif Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa ture xumuruuf, marsaa gara marsaatti meeshaa waraanaa hiikuuf waliigaltee irra ga'eera. Waliigaltee kanaan, Hamaas meeshaa isaa yoo hiike, waraanni Israa'el naannichaa gadi lakkisee akka bahu eegama. Maddoleen araaraa fi mootummaan Amerikaa tarkaanfii kana karaa nageenyaa seena qabeessa ta'e jedhanii kan fudhatan ta'us, waliigalteen kun milkaa'uu isaa irratti shakkiin guddaan jira; kunis kan ta'eef carraaqqiin duraan turan waan hin milkoofneef fi wal amantummaan gamtaalee lamaan gidduu jiru waan xiqqaateefidha.

title: Trump says Hamas disarmament deal will be complex to deliver
english: Donald Trump has highlighted a proposal aimed at the full disarmament of Hamas, which Israel reportedly backs as a major regional milestone. However, the former president warned that successfully implementing this plan will be difficult and may encounter several obstacles. He noted that the intricate nature of the conflict means the process is likely to experience significant setbacks and challenges.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሃማስን ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ የማስፈታት እቅድ መኖሩን ጠቅሰው፣ እስራኤል ለዚህ ስምምነት ትልቅ ድጋፍ እንዳላት ገልጸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ ይህንን እቅድ በተግባር ላይ ማዋል እጅግ ውስብስብ እና ብዙ ውጣ ውረዶች የሚኖሩት ሂደት እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በትጥቅ ማስፈታት ሂደቱ ውስጥ የተለያዩ ተግዳሮቶች ሊያጋጥሙ እንደሚችሉም አክለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump karoora Hamas guutummaatti hidhanno hiiksisuu danda'u tokko kan ibsan yoo ta'u, Israa'el yaada kana deggeruu ishee ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hojiin kun rakkoo fi walxxiinsa qabaachuu isaa fi raawwii isaa keessatti gufuun hedduun akka mudatan hubachiisaniiru. Adeemsi kun haala siyaasaa naannichaa irraa kan ka'e jijjiiramaa fi rakkoolee hedduu of keessatti kan qabu ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Syrian lawyer takes on ex-Assad official in landmark trial
english: Syrian lawyer Nouha al-Masri is leading a significant legal battle against Atef Najib, a former official under the Assad regime. Najib is being prosecuted for his involvement in severe human rights abuses, including torture and murder during the 2011 uprisings. This trial represents a crucial step for victims seeking accountability for the violence that occurred during the Syrian conflict.
amharic: ሶሪያዊቷ ጠበቃ ኑሃ አል-ማስሪ በአሳድ አገዛዝ ሥር የቀድሞ ባለስልጣን በነበሩት አቴፍ ናጂብ ላይ ወሳኝ የህግ ክስ እየመሩ ነው። ናጂብ በ2011 በተደረገው አመጽ ወቅት በደረሰው ስቃይ፣ ግድያ እና የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ተከስሰዋል። ይህ ክስ ለግጭቱ ሰለባዎች ፍትህን ለማስፈን ትልቅ ትርጉም ያለው እንቅስቃሴ ነው።
oromo: Abukaattoon lammii Suuriyaa Nuuhaa Al-Masrii jedhamtu, qondaala mootummaa Asaad duraanii Ateef Najiib irratti himata seeraa dhiyeessiteetti. Najiib bara 2011 fincila biyyattii keessatti ka'e yeroo sana reebicha, ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwachuun himatameera. Dhaddachi kun namoota miidhaan irra gaheef haqaa barbaaduuf tarkaanfii murteessaadha.

title: Why is Israel arming illegal settlers?
english: The Israeli government has distributed over 100,000 assault rifles to settlers in the occupied West Bank. This policy comes amid a significant rise in attacks committed by settlers against the local Palestinian population. Critics are concerned that this increased arming of civilians will further endanger Palestinians living in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ለሚኖሩ ሰፈራ ተቋቋሚዎች ከ100,000 በላይ አውቶማቲክ ጠመንጃዎችን አከፋፍሏል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በሰፈራ ተቋቋሚዎች በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በደረሱበት ወቅት ነው። በነዚህ ታጣቂ ሰፋሪዎች ምክንያት በክልሉ የሚኖሩ የፓለስቲናውያን ህይወት ለከፍተኛ አደጋ መጋለጡ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa (West Bank) keessatti qubataalee seeraan alaa ta'aniif qawweewwan waraanaa 100,000 ol raabseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo miidhaan fi haleellaan qubataaleen kunniin saba Palesxiin irratti raawwatan daran dabalaa jiruudha. Hidhannoon kun naannichatti jireenya Palesxiinotaaf sodaa guddaa uumeera.

title: New York sues Kalshi, says its prediction markets are ‘illegal gambling’
english: The New York Attorney General has filed a lawsuit against the prediction market platform Kalshi, labeling its betting services on political and sporting events as illegal gambling. The state argues that Kalshi lacks the necessary local licenses and poses risks to public health, particularly for younger users. While the company claims it should be governed by federal authorities, New York is demanding that the platform pay fines and give up profits earned from these operations.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ ካልሺ በተሰኘው የትንበያ ገበያ መድረክ ላይ ህገ-ወጥ የቁማር ስራዎችን እያከናወነ ነው በሚል ክስ መስርቷል። ግዛቱ ኩባንያው አስፈላጊው የአካባቢ ፈቃድ እንደሌለው እና በተለይም ለወጣቶች የጤና ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር ይከራከራል። ኩባንያው በፌዴራል መንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር መሆን እንዳለበት ቢገልጽም፣ የኒውዮርክ ግዛት ግን ከዚህ ተግባር ያገኘውን ትርፍ እንዲያስረክብ እና ቅጣት እንዲከፍል ጠይቋል።
oromo: Abbaan Alangaa New York dhaabbata makirkeetii raaguu (prediction market) kan ta'e Kalshi irratti, tajaajila addunyaa isaa kanneen akka tapha ispoortii fi siyaasaa irratti gamachuu seeraan alaa gaggeessaa jira jechuun himata dhiheesseera. Bulchiinsi naannichaa, dhaabbatichi hayyama barbaachisaa kan hin qabne ta'uu fi keessattuu dargaggoota irratti rakkoo fayyaa akka uumu ibseera. Kalshiin seera federaalaatiin buluu qabna jedhee falatus, mootummaan New York garuu bu'aa dhaabbatichi argate akka deebisuufi adabbii akka kaffalu gaafataa jira.

title: Trump says Israel 'very happy' with Gaza disarmament agreement
english: Donald Trump stated that Israeli officials are pleased with a new deal brokered by his peace committee. This agreement focuses on the total removal of weapons from Hamas and other militant factions operating in Gaza. The initiative aims to stabilize the region through the disarmament of these groups.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በእሳቸው የሰላም ኮሚቴ በተደረሰ ስምምነት መደሰታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ስምምነቱ ሀማስን እና በጋዛ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ሌሎች ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ ለማስፈታት ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ በአካባቢው ዘላቂ ሰላም ለማምጣት ታሳቢ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Donald Trump akka ibsetti, mootummaan Israa'el waliigaltee garee nagaa inni hundeesseen amansiifamee fi nagaa ta'uu ibseera. Waliigaltee kun garee Hamas fi gareewwan hidhattoota Gaa'zaa keessa jiran hunda irraa meeshaa waraanaa guutummaatti hiiksisuuf kan karoorfame dha. Kaayyoon isaa gurguddaan naannichatti tasgabbii fiduu dha.

title: Israeli strike injures several people in Gaza
english: Multiple Israeli drone and air strikes across the Gaza Strip have resulted in casualties, including deaths and serious injuries. Attacks were reported in both Deir el-Balah and near Gaza City, affecting civilians such as women and children. The ongoing military actions continue to impact various locations throughout the region.
amharic: በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በእስራኤል የድሮን እና የአየር ጥቃቶች ምክንያት የሰው ህይወት ማለፉንና በርካቶች መቁሰላቸውን ዘገባዎች ያመለክታሉ። ጥቃቶቹ በዴይር ኤል-ባላህ እና በጋዛ ከተማ አካባቢ የተፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው መካከል ሴቶችና ህጻናት ይገኙበታል። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች በክልሉ ባሉ የተለያዩ ስፍራዎች ላይ ተጽዕኖ ማሳደራቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el iddoowwan adda addaa Gaazaa keessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi doonii geggeesseen lubbuun namootaa darbuu fi namoonni hedduun miidhamuu gabaasni ni mul'isa. Haleellaan kunneen Deeyr el-Balaah fi naannoo magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti kan raawwataman yoo ta'u, miidhaan irra ga'e keessaa dubartootaa fi daa'imman kan argamanidha. Tarkaanfiin waraanaas naannichatti haala jiru daran hammaachaa jira.

title: US says Strait of Hormuz ‘remains open’
english: The United States military has officially denied Iran's claims that the Strait of Hormuz is closed, asserting that the waterway remains fully open to international trade. Despite Iran's report that it intercepted several ships in the area, US officials maintain that Iran does not hold control over this vital shipping lane. Thousands of commercial vessels have continued to travel through the passage without disruption over recent months.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ተዘግቷል በሚል ኢራን ያቀረበችውን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ስትሬቱ አሁንም ለንግድ መርከቦች ክፍት እንደሆነና ኢራንም በእሱ ላይ ቁጥጥር እንደሌላት አሜሪካ አሳውቃለች። ባለፉት ጥቂት ወራት ውስጥ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ መርከቦች ያለምንም ችግር በውሃ መስመሩ በኩል መተላለፋቸውን የዩኤስ ሴንትራል ኮማንድ ገልጿል።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa himata mootummaan Iraan handhuurri galaana Hormuz cufameera jedhu soba jechuun haaleera. Galana kun daldala idil-addunyaaf kan baname ta'uu fi Iraanis guutummaatti to'annoo isaa akka hin qabne ibsameera. Ji'oota darban keessa markaawwan daldalaa kumaan lakkaa'aman rakkoo tokko malee karaa kana fayyadamaa akka jiran ajajni waraana Ameerikaa beeksiseera.

title: Iraq to strengthen air defence, readiness after US-Saudi strikes
english: Following recent US-Saudi military strikes against the Hashed al-Shaabi, the Iraqi government has mandated an immediate increase in security alertness at all military facilities. Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has prioritized the modernization of the nation’s radar and air defense systems to enhance national protection. This move aims to bolster intelligence and defensive readiness across all official armed forces bases in response to regional tensions.
amharic: በቅርቡ በሃሼድ አል-ሻቢ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የአሜሪካና የሳውዲ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ የኢራቅ መንግስት በሁሉም ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ ከፍተኛ የጥንቃቄ ደረጃ እንዲወሰድ አዟል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አሊ አል-ዛይዲ የአገሪቱን የአየር መከላከያና የራዳር ቴክኖሎጂን የማዘመን ስራ እንደ ዋና ቅድሚያ እንደሚሰጡ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት መሰረት በማድረግ የአገሪቱን የደህንነትና የመከላከያ አቅም ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Saudii garee Hashed al-Shaabi irratti erga raawwatamee booda, mootummaan Iraaq bakkee waraanaa hundatti eeggannoo cimaa akka godhamu ajajeera. Muummeen Ministiraa Alii al-Zayidii, sirna raadaaraa fi ittisa qilleensa biyyattii ammayyeessuun dhimma ariifachiisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun haala naannichaa ilaalchisee fedhii biyyattii eeguuf jecha qophii fi dandeettii ittisa biyyattii cimsachuu kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: Israeli military cracks down on West Bank village as settlers march in
english: Israeli forces blocked access to the West Bank village of Tal and conducted arrests while over 100 settlers marched into the area. This follows a recent period of increased violence where both Palestinians and Israelis have been killed. Local residents claim they are being targeted by settlers attempting to force them off their land, leading to frequent military raids in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው ታልክ መንደር መግቢያዎችን በመዝጋትና በመውረር በርካታ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል፤ በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ከ100 በላይ የሚሆኑ ሰፋሪዎች ወደ መንደሩ ዘምተዋል። ይህ ግጭት የተከሰተው በቅርቡ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል በተፈጠረውና የበርካታ ሰዎችን ህይወት በቀጠፈው የኃይል እርምጃ ሳቢያ ነው። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ሰፋሪዎች ከመሬታቸው ለማፈናቀል እንደሚሞክሩ በመግለጽ የራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እየታገሉ መሆናቸውን ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el ganda Taals jedhamtu kan Qarqara Lixaa keessatti argamtu keessatti namoota hedduu hidhuu fi karaa cufuun tarkaanfii fudhateera, yeroo sanatti namoonni ganda sanaa keessatti qubatan 100 ol gara gandichaatti imalaniiru. Gochi kun kan hordofe walitti bu'iinsa dhihoo kana biyyattii keessatti geggeeffame kan lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafate dha. Jiraattonni gandichaa akka jedhanitti, qubattoonni kun lafa isaanii irraa isaan buusuuf akka isaan miidhaa jiran himuun, ofirraa ittisuuf akka dirqaman ibsaniiru.

title: FIFA COO Lamour says staff deceived over Infantino’s World Cup plan
english: FIFA's Chief Operating Officer, Kevin Lamour, has publicly accused President Gianni Infantino of misleading staff regarding a controversial plan to sell stakes in future World Cup profits to private investors. Lamour argues that the project is driven solely by Infantino and insists it should be halted, even if it costs him his position. This criticism follows the resignation of senior advisor Carlos Cordeiro, who similarly denounced the $20 billion proposal as detrimental to the sport.
amharic: የፊፋ ዋና ኦፕሬቲንግ ኦፊሰር ኬቨን ላሙር፣ የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የወደፊት የዓለም ዋንጫ ትርፍን ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ባቀዱት እቅድ ሰራተኞቻቸውን እንዳታለሉ በይፋ ከሰሱ። ላሙር ይህ እቅድ የአንድ ሰው ፍላጎት ብቻ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ስራቸውን ቢያጡም እንኳን ፕሮጀክቱ መቆም እንዳለበት አጥብቀው ተናግረዋል። ይህ ተቃውሞ የተሰማው ከፍተኛ አማካሪ ካርሎስ ኮርዴይሮ፣ የ20 ቢሊዮን ዶላሩን ሀሳብ ለስፖርቱ ጎጂ ነው በማለት ከስራ መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan hojii FIFA Kevin Lamour, pirezidaantiin FIFA Gianni Infantino karoora bu'aa Wolgaa'ii Kubbaa Miillaa Addunyaa (World Cup) gara fuulduraa irratti harka qabaachuu danda'an dhaabbilee dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfatan ilaalchisee hojjettoota isaa gowwoomsuu isaa ifatti himateera. Lamour karoora kana kan baasee fi kan dhuunfatee Infantino qofa akka ta'e dubbatee, kanaan hojiisaa dhabuu kan danda'u ta'us, hojiin kun guutummaatti dhaabbachuu qaba jedheera. Qeequn kun kan dhufe, gorsaan olaanaa Carlos Cordeiro jedhamu karoora $20 biliyoonii ta'e kana qooddachuu diduun hojiisaa gadi lakkisee ba'uu isaa hordofee dha.

title: Western allies warn North Korean IT workers funding nuclear arsenal
english: A group of Western nations has issued a warning regarding North Korean IT workers who use fake identities to secure remote jobs globally. These workers utilize artificial intelligence and other methods to earn money, which is then sent to Pyongyang to support its illegal nuclear weapons program. The coalition urges companies to improve their security and verification processes to prevent these individuals from engaging in cybercrime and corporate espionage.
amharic: የምዕራባውያን ሀገራት ጥምረት በዓለም ዙሪያ በሚገኙ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ውስጥ በውሸት ማንነት ተቀጥረው የሚሰሩ የሰሜን ኮሪያ ሰራተኞች ላይ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። እነዚህ ሰራተኞች አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን በመጠቀም የሚያገኙትን ገቢ ለሰሜን ኮሪያ የተከለከሉ የኑክሌር የጦር መሳሪያ ፕሮግራሞች ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ይጠቀሙበታል። ኩባንያዎች የሳይበር ወንጀልን እና የስለላ ስራን ለመከላከል የቅጥር እና የማጣራት ሂደታቸውን እንዲያጠናክሩ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Mootummoonni biyyoota lixaa garee hojjettoota teeknoolojii (IT) kan biyya Kooriyaa Kaabaa irraa dhufanii maqaa sobaan hojiiwwan intarneetii irratti argatan irratti akeekkachiisa kennaniiru. Hojjettoonni kun qarshii meeshaalee waraanaa niwukilaaraa biyyattii deeggaruuf oolu argachuuf, gargaarsa 'artificial intelligence' fayyadamuun hojiin alaa akka hojjetan ibsameera. Dhaabbileen daldalaa fi bakkeewwan hojii namoota kana irraa fayyadamuu dhabuuf jecha, sirna eenyummaa mirkaneessuu isaanii akka jabeessan gorfamaniiru.

title: DR Congo Ebola epidemic becomes world’s second largest outbreak
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is currently facing the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, with over 3,500 recorded cases. Health officials report that this specific epidemic is spreading at an unprecedented speed, further complicated by a lack of vaccines for this strain and severe security issues in the region. Humanitarian groups are struggling to manage the crisis due to limited international funding and growing community distrust toward response efforts.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከ3,500 በላይ በሆኑ ጉዳዮች በታሪክ ሁለተኛው ትልቅ የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ገጥሟታል። የጤና ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ይህ ወረርሽኝ ከዚህ ቀደም ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ ሲሆን ለዚህ የቫይረስ ዝርያ ምንም አይነት ክትባት አለመኖሩ እና በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ችግር ሁኔታውን አባብሶታል። አለም አቀፍ ድጋፎች በመቀነሱ እና በህብረተሰቡ ዘንድ ባለመተማመን ምክንያት የሰብአዊ ድርጅቶች የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመግታት ከፍተኛ ችግር እየገጠማቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola hanga ammaatti namoota 3,500 ol hubachuun, seenaa addunyaa keessatti dhibee kanaa isa lammaffaa cimaa taasiseera. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa akka ibsanitti, dhibeen kun saffisaan babal'achaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, talaaliin dhibee kanaaf hin jirre fi rakkoon nageenyaa naannichaa haala isaa ulfeesseera. Gargaarsi idil-addunyaa hir'achuu fi amantaan hawaasni toftaalee ittisaa irratti qabu laafaa waan ta'eef, dhaabbileen gargaarsaa dhibicha to'achuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: Three-year roadmap proposed for Hamas disarmament in Gaza
english: A new US-supported plan outlines a three-year strategy to transition Gaza into a demilitarized zone. The proposal requires both Hamas and Israel to conclude political negotiations within two weeks. Once this phase is complete, Hamas will begin disarming while Israeli forces initiate a gradual withdrawal from the region.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበ አዲስ እቅድ ጋዛን ከጦር መሳሪያ ነጻ የሆነ ቀጠና ለማድረግ የሚያስችል የሶስት አመት የሽግግር ስልት ይዟል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት ሀማስ እና እስራኤል የፖለቲካ የሽግግር ሂደቱን ለመጨረስ የ14 ቀናት ጊዜ ተሰጥቷቸዋል። ሂደቱ ከተሳካ በኋላ ሀማስ ትጥቅ መፍታት ይጀምራል፣ እስራኤልም ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ በደረጃ ታስወጣለች።
oromo: Karoorri haaraa Ameerikaan deggerame tokko, gaazaan naannoo meeshaa waraanaa irraa bilisa ta'e akka taatuuf yeroo waggaa sadii fudhatu baaseera. Karoorichi Hamas fi Israa'el jijjiirrama siyaasaa kana xumuruuf guyyaa 14 akka qabaatan gaafata. Yoo kun milkaa'e, Hamas meeshaa isaa hiikuu kan jalqabu yoo ta'u, Israa'el immoo waraana ishee naannichaa irraa gadi lakkisuu eegalti.

title: LIVE: Chopra, Nadeem and Pathirage meet in Commonwealth Games javelin final
english: The 2026 Commonwealth Games javelin final is taking place today at Scotstoun Stadium in Glasgow, Scotland. The event features a highly anticipated rivalry between India's Neeraj Chopra and Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem. Rumesh Pathirage is also competing as a top contender in the match, which is scheduled to start at 8:15 PM local time.
amharic: የ2026 የኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች የጦር ውርወራ ፍጻሜ በስኮትላንድ ግላዝጎ ስቶትስቶን ስታዲየም ዛሬ ይካሄዳል። ውድድሩ በህንድ አትሌት ኒራጅ ቾፕራ እና በፓኪስታኑ አርሻድ ናዲም መካከል ያለውን ተጠባቂ ፍልሚያ ያካትታል። ሩመሽ ፓቲራጌም በውድድሩ ዋነኛ ተፎካካሪ ሆኖ ሲሳተፍ፣ ውድድሩም በሀገር ውስጥ ሰዓት አቆጣጠር ምሽት 2፡15 ላይ እንደሚጀመር ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Fiigicha cimaa ispoortii 2026 kan Commonwealth Games kan darbachuu eeboo (javelin) har'a istaadiyeemii Scotstoun kan magaala Glasgow, Scotland keessatti geggeeffamaa jira. Qophiin kun morkii cimaa ispoortistoota Neeraj Chopra kan Indiyaa fi Arshad Nadeem kan Paakistaan gidduutti godhamu kan hordofamuudha. Rumesh Pathirage-nis akka morkataa guddaatti kan hirmaatu yoo ta'u, qophiin kun sa'aatii 8:15 galgalaatti kan jalqabu ta'a.
